description: This file defines a Flutter widget named LessonCategoryCard, which is a customizable, interactive category card with background color, icon, and title. It handles tap interactions with visual feedback and follows a specific visual style.

classes.name: LessonCategoryCard
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a customizable category card with an icon, title, background color, text color, and optional tap callback.

classes.name: _LessonCategoryCardState
classes.description: State class managing the interaction state (_pressed) and building the widget tree with gesture detection and scaling animation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree, applying scale animation based on tap interaction, and layouts the icon and text within styled containers.
